title: Gel-elongation assay for type II fatty acid synthesis
protocol: Preincubate 0.25 - 2 μg of E. coli or S. aureus lysate with serial dilutions of inhibitors at room temperature for 20 min in 50 μl of buffer containing specific components.
Initiate the reaction by adding 10 μl of water-diluted [C-14]malonyl-CoA to achieve a final concentration of 4 μM malonyl-CoA.
Incubate the reaction at 37°C for 30 min for E. coli lysate and 60 min for S. aureus lysate.
After incubation, mix 10 μl (plus 10 μl 2X native sample buffer) of each sample with a l6% polyacrylamide gel containing urea as needed.
Resolve the gel and transfer it to a PVDF membrane.
Expose the membrane to Phosphor Screen and visualize using a PhosphorImager scanner.
